count_semantics: record_count is the number of products the catalogue reports for the node (not variants); own_record_count is the node's own listing count, child_sum is the sum of its children (children overlap, so child_sum can exceed the true unique count), count_source says which one was used. Department counts come from a department-level catalogue query, so summing them can exceed the market total (unisex items are listed under both 女装 and 男装).
